verses.18:21: And seek out for yourself from all the people capable men, fearing God, righteous men, hating arrogance, and you shall appoint over them rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, and rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens;
verses.18:22: and they shall judge the people at all times; the matter that is too great they shall bring to you, but the small judgments they themselves shall judge; and they shall lighten the burden from you and help bear it with you.
verses.18:23: If you do this thing, God shall strengthen you, and you will be able to endure, and all this people shall come to their own place in peace."
verses.18:24: So Moses heeded the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said to him.
verses.18:25: And Moses chose capable men out of all Israel, and made them over them rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, and rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens;
verses.18:26: and they judged the people at all times; every weighty matter they brought to Moses, but every light matter they themselves judged.
verses.18:27: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and he departed into his own land.
verses.19:1: Now in the third month of the departure of the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt, on this very day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.19:2: For they departed from Rephidim and came into the wilderness of Sinai, and Israel encamped there opposite the mountain.
verses.19:3: And Moses went up to the mountain of God; and God called to him out of heaven, saying, "Thus you shall say to the house of Jacob, and declare to the sons of Israel:
verses.19:4: 'You yourselves have seen all that I have done to the Egyptians, and how I took you up as upon wings of eagles, and brought you to Myself.
verses.19:5: And now, if you will indeed heed My voice and keep My covenant, you shall be to Me a treasured people above all the nations; for all the earth is Mine,
verses.19:6: and you shall be for Me a royal priesthood and a holy nation.' These words you shall speak to the sons of Israel."
verses.19:7: So Moses came and spoke to the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which God had commanded him.
verses.19:8: And all the people answered with one accord and said, "All that God has spoken we will do, and we will obey." And Moses brought back these words to God.
verses.19:9: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I am coming to you in a pillar of cloud, that the people may hear when I speak to you, and may believe you forever." And Moses reported the words of the people to the Lord.
verses.19:10: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go down and solemnly charge the people, and purify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
verses.19:11: and let them be ready for the third day; for on the third day the Lord will come down upon Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
verses.19:12: And you shall set bounds for the people round about, saying, 'Take heed to yourselves not to go up onto the mountain or touch any part of it; everyone who touches the mountain shall surely die.
verses.19:13: No hand shall touch him, for he shall surely be stoned with stones or shot through with a dart; whether beast or man, it shall not live.' When the sounds and the trumpets and the cloud depart from the mountain, they shall go up upon the mountain."
verses.19:14: So Moses went down from the mountain to the people and sanctified them, and they washed their garments.
verses.19:15: And he said to the people, "Be ready for three days; do not come near a woman."
verses.19:16: And it came to pass on the third day, as it drew toward dawn, that there came thunderings and lightnings and a dark cloud upon Mount Sinai, and the sound of the trumpet resounded loudly; and all the people who were in the camp were terrified.
verses.19:17: And Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet God, and they stood at the foot of Mount Sinai.
verses.19:18: Now Mount Sinai was altogether in smoke, because God had descended upon it in fire, and the smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace; and all the people were exceedingly astounded.
verses.19:19: And the sounds of the trumpet went on growing exceedingly louder; Moses spoke, and God answered him with a voice.
verses.19:20: And the Lord came down upon Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain; and the Lord called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
verses.19:21: And God spoke to Moses, saying, "Go down and solemnly charge the people, lest they draw near to God to gaze intently, and a multitude of them fall;
verses.19:22: and let the priests who draw near to the Lord God be sanctified, lest the Lord depart from them."
verses.19:23: And Moses said to God, "The people will not be able to come up to Mount Sinai; for You Yourself solemnly charged us, saying, 'Set bounds around the mountain and sanctify it.'"
verses.19:24: And the Lord said to him, "Go, descend, and come up, you and Aaron with you; but do not let the priests and the people force their way to come up to God, lest the Lord destroy some of them."
verses.19:25: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
verses.20:1: And the Lord spoke all these words, saying:
verses.20:2: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you forth from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.20:3: You shall have no other gods besides Me.
verses.20:4: You shall not make for yourself an idol, nor a likeness of anything—whatever is in heaven above, and whatever is on the earth beneath, and whatever is in the waters underneath the earth.
verses.20:5: You shall not bow down to them nor shall you serve them; for I am the Lord your God, a jealous God, repaying the sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate Me,
verses.20:6: and showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and to those who keep My ordinances.
verses.20:7: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain; for the Lord your God will by no means acquit the one who takes His name in vain.
verses.20:8: Remember the Sabbath day, to sanctify it.
verses.20:9: Six days you shall labor and perform all your works,
verses.20:10: but on the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God; you shall not do any work in it—you and your son and your daughter, your manservant and your maidservant, your ox and your beast of burden and all your cattle, and the stranger who sojourns among you.
verses.20:11: For in six days the Lord made the heaven and the earth and all things that are in them, and He rested on the seventh day; therefore the Lord blessed the seventh day and sanctified it.
verses.20:12: Honor your father and mother, that it may be well with you, and that you may live long upon the good land which the Lord your God is giving to you.
verses.20:16: You shall not testify with false witness against your neighbor.
verses.20:17: You shall not covet your neighbor's wife; you shall not covet your neighbor's house, nor his field, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his beast of burden, nor any of his cattle, nor whatever belongs to your neighbor."
verses.20:18: And all the people saw the voice and the flashes and the sound of the trumpet and the mountain smoking; and all the people were afraid and stood afar off,
verses.20:19: and they said to Moses, "You speak to us, and do not let God speak to us, lest we die."
verses.20:20: And Moses said to them, "Take courage; for God has come to you in order to test you, so that the fear of Him may be in you, that you may not sin."
verses.20:21: And the people stood afar off, while Moses entered into the thick darkness where God was.
verses.20:22: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Thus you shall say to the house of Jacob and declare to the sons of Israel: 'You yourselves have seen that I have spoken to you from heaven.
verses.20:23: You shall not make for yourselves gods of silver, and gods of gold you shall not make for yourselves.
verses.20:24: An altar of earth you shall make for Me, and you shall sacrifice upon it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, and your sheep and your calves, in every place where I shall name My name there; and I will come to you and bless you.
verses.20:25: And if you make an altar of stones for Me, you shall not build them hewn; for you have laid your hand tool upon them, and they have been defiled.
verses.20:26: You shall not go up by steps to My altar, so that you may not uncover your nakedness upon it.'"
verses.21:1: "And these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:
verses.21:2: If you acquire a Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve you; and in the seventh year he shall depart free, without payment.
verses.21:3: If he comes in alone, he shall also go out alone; and if a wife comes in with him, the wife shall also go out with him.
verses.21:4: And if the master gives him a wife, and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and the children shall belong to his master, and he himself shall go out alone.
verses.21:5: But if the servant answers and says, 'I have loved my master and my wife and my children; I will not depart free,'
verses.21:6: then his master shall bring him to the judgment seat of God, and then he shall bring him to the door, to the doorpost; and his master shall pierce his ear with the awl, and he shall serve him forever.
verses.21:7: And if anyone sells his own daughter as a household servant, she shall not depart as the female slaves depart.
verses.21:8: If she whom he betrothed to himself does not please her master, he shall let her be redeemed; yet he has no authority to sell her to a foreign nation, because he has broken faith with her.
verses.21:9: And if he betroths her to his son, he shall deal with her according to the ordinance for daughters.
verses.21:10: And if he takes another wife, he shall not withhold her necessities, and her clothing, and her marital companionship.
verses.21:11: And if he does not do these three things for her, she shall go out free, without silver.
verses.21:12: And if anyone strikes someone so that he dies, he shall surely be put to death;
verses.21:13: but if he did not do so willingly, rather God delivered him into his hands, then I will give you a place to which the one who killed may flee.
verses.21:14: But if anyone sets upon his neighbor to kill him by guile, and flees for refuge, you shall take him from My altar to put him to death.
verses.21:15: Whoever strikes his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
verses.21:16: The one who speaks evil of his father or his mother shall surely die.
verses.21:17: Whoever steals any one of the sons of Israel and, having overpowered him, sells him, and he is found in his possession, shall surely die.
verses.21:18: And if two men quarrel and strike a neighbor with a stone or with a fist, and he does not die, but is laid up upon his bed,
verses.21:19: if the man rises up and walks about outside upon a staff, then the one who struck him shall be guiltless; only he shall pay for his loss of labor and the healing expenses.
verses.21:20: And if anyone strikes his manservant or his maidservant with a rod, and he dies under his hands, he shall surely be punished with justice.
verses.21:21: Yet if he survives one day or two, he shall not be punished; for he is his silver.
verses.21:22: And if two men fight and strike a woman who is with child, and her child comes out not yet formed, he shall surely be fined; according to whatever the woman's husband imposes, he shall pay with an assessment.
verses.21:23: But if it was formed, he shall give life for life,
verses.21:24: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.21:25: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
verses.21:26: And if anyone strikes the eye of his manservant or the eye of his maidservant and blinds it, he shall send them away free for their eye.
verses.21:27: And if he knocks out the tooth of his manservant or the tooth of his maidservant, he shall send them away free for their tooth.
verses.21:28: And if a bull gores a man or a woman, and that person dies, the bull shall surely be stoned with stones, and its flesh shall not be eaten; and the owner of the bull shall be guiltless.
verses.21:29: But if the bull was given to goring before yesterday and before the third day, and testimony was given to its owner, and he did not do away with it, and it kills a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned and its owner shall be put to death as well.
verses.21:30: Yet if a ransom is imposed upon him, he shall pay as a ransom for his life whatever they impose upon him.
verses.21:31: And if it gores a son or a daughter, according to this ordinance they shall do to him.
verses.21:32: And if the bull gores a manservant or a maidservant, he shall pay thirty didrachmas of silver to their master, and the bull shall be stoned.
verses.21:33: And if anyone opens a pit, or hews out a pit, and does not cover it, and a calf or a donkey falls into it,
verses.21:34: the owner of the pit shall make restitution; he shall pay silver to their owner, and the dead animal shall belong to him.
verses.21:35: And if someone's bull gores his neighbor's bull, and it dies, they shall sell the living bull and divide its silver, and the dead bull they shall also divide.
verses.21:36: But if the bull is known to be given to goring before yesterday and before the third day, and testimony has been given to its owner, and he has not done away with it, he shall pay bull for bull, and the dead one shall belong to him.
verses.21:37: And if anyone steals a calf or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it, he shall pay five calves for the calf and four sheep for the sheep."
verses.22:1: And if the thief is found breaking in, and he is struck and dies, there is no bloodguilt for him;
verses.22:2: but if the sun has risen upon him, he is guilty; he shall die in return. And if he has nothing, let him be sold for the theft.
verses.22:3: And if what was stolen is seized and found in his hand, from donkey even to sheep, alive, he shall restore them twofold.
verses.22:4: And if anyone grazes a field or a vineyard, and lets his livestock loose to graze another field, he shall make restitution from his own field according to its yield; and if he grazes the entire field, he shall restore the best of his own field and the best of his own vineyard.
verses.22:5: And if fire breaks out and catches thorns, and also burns up threshing floors, or ears of grain, or a field, the one who kindled the fire shall make restitution.
verses.22:6: And if anyone gives silver or articles to his neighbor to keep, and it is stolen from the man's house, if the one who stole it is found, he shall pay twofold;
verses.22:7: but if the one who stole it is not found, the master of the house shall come before God and shall swear that he surely has not acted wickedly regarding any part of his neighbor's deposit.
verses.22:8: In every stated case of wrongdoing—whether concerning a calf, or a beast of burden, or a sheep, or a garment, or any lost thing for which a claim is made, whatever it may be—the case of both parties shall come before God, and the one convicted through God shall pay twofold to his neighbor.
verses.22:9: And if anyone gives to his neighbor a beast of burden, or a calf, or a sheep, or any livestock to keep, and it is maimed, or dies, or is taken captive, and no one knows,
verses.22:10: an oath of God shall be between both of them, that he surely has not acted wickedly at all regarding his neighbor's deposit; and so its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.22:11: But if it is stolen from him, he shall make restitution to the owner;
verses.22:12: and if it is seized by a wild beast, he shall bring him to the prey, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.22:13: And if anyone borrows from his neighbor, and it is maimed, or dies, or is taken captive, while its owner is not with it, he shall make restitution;
verses.22:14: but if the owner is with it, he shall not make restitution; and if it is hired, it shall be to him in place of its hire.
verses.22:15: And if anyone seduces a virgin who is not betrothed and lies with her, he shall surely pay the bride-price for her to be his wife.
verses.22:16: But if her father utterly refuses and is not willing to give her to him as a wife, he shall pay silver to the father according to the amount of the bride-price of virgins.
verses.22:17: You shall not permit sorcerers to live.
verses.22:18: Everyone who lies with a beast, you shall surely put them to death.
verses.22:19: The one who sacrifices to gods, except to the Lord alone, shall surely be destroyed by death.
verses.22:20: And you shall not mistreat a sojourner, nor shall you oppress him; for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.22:21: You shall not mistreat any widow or orphan;
verses.22:22: and if you grievously mistreat them, and crying out they cry aloud to Me, I will surely hear their voice;
verses.22:23: and I will be enraged with wrath, and I will slay you with the sword, and your wives shall become widows and your children orphans.
verses.22:24: And if you lend silver to the poor brother who is with you, you shall not press hard upon him; you shall not lay interest upon him.
verses.22:25: And if you indeed take your neighbor's garment as a pledge, you shall return it to him before the setting of the sun;
verses.22:26: for this is his covering, this alone is the garment for his nakedness; in what shall he sleep? Therefore if he cries aloud to Me, I will hear him, for I am merciful.
verses.22:27: You shall not revile gods, nor speak evil of the rulers of your people.
verses.22:28: You shall not delay the firstfruits of your threshing floor and your winepress; the firstborn of your sons you shall give to Me.
verses.22:29: Likewise you shall do with your calf, and your sheep, and your beast of burden: seven days it shall be under its mother, and on the eighth day you shall render it to Me.
verses.22:30: And you shall be holy men to Me; and flesh seized by a wild beast you shall not eat; cast it to the dog.
verses.23:1: You shall not receive a vain report; you shall not join in agreement with the unrighteous to become an unrighteous witness.
verses.23:2: You shall not be with the many in evil; you shall not side with a multitude to turn aside with the many, so as to shut out justice.
verses.23:3: And you shall not pity a poor man in judgment.
verses.23:4: And if you meet your enemy's ox or his beast of burden going astray, you shall turn it back and restore it to him.
verses.23:5: And if you see your enemy's beast of burden fallen beneath its burden, you shall not pass it by, but you shall lift it up together with him.
verses.23:6: You shall not pervert the judgment of a poor man in his cause.
verses.23:7: From every unjust matter you shall keep far away; the innocent and righteous you shall not slay, and you shall not justify the ungodly for the sake of bribes.
verses.23:8: And you shall not accept bribes; for bribes blind the eyes of those who see, and corrupt righteous words.
verses.23:9: And you shall not oppress a sojourner; for you know the soul of a sojourner, since you yourselves were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.23:10: Six years you shall sow your land and gather in its produce;
verses.23:11: but in the seventh you shall grant a release and leave it uncultivated, and the poor of your nation shall eat; and what is left over the wild beasts shall eat. Likewise you shall do with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
verses.23:12: Six days you shall do your works, but on the seventh day there shall be rest, that your ox and your beast of burden may rest, and that the son of your maidservant and the sojourner may rest.
verses.23:13: Observe all things that I have spoken to you; and you shall not call to mind the name of other gods, nor shall it be heard from your mouth.
verses.23:14: Three times in the year you shall keep a feast to Me.
verses.23:15: You shall take care to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread: seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, just as I commanded you, at the appointed time of the month of new crops, for in it you came out of Egypt. You shall not appear before Me empty-handed.
verses.23:16: And you shall keep the Feast of Harvest of the firstfruits of your labors that you sow in your field, and the Feast of Completion at the outgoing of the year, in the gathering in of your labors from your field.
verses.23:17: Three times in the year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord your God.
verses.23:18: For when I cast out nations from before your face and enlarge your borders, you shall not sacrifice the blood of My incense-offering upon leaven, nor shall the fat of My feast remain overnight until morning.
verses.23:19: The firstfruits of your first-produce you shall bring into the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother's milk.
verses.23:20: And behold, I send My angel before your face to guard you in the way, that he may bring you into the land which I have prepared for you.
verses.23:21: Take heed to yourself and listen to him, and do not disobey him; for he will by no means shrink back from you, for My name is upon him.
verses.23:22: If you indeed listen to My voice, and do all things that I command you, and keep My covenant, you shall be to Me a treasured people from among all the nations; for all the earth is Mine, and you shall be to Me a royal priesthood and a holy nation. These words you shall speak to the sons of Israel. If you indeed listen to My voice, and do all things that I say to you, I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.
verses.23:23: For My angel shall go leading before you, and he shall bring you in to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, and I will blot them out.
verses.23:24: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor shall you serve them; you shall not do according to their works, but you shall utterly demolish them and shatter their pillars in pieces.
verses.23:25: And you shall serve the Lord your God, and I will bless your bread, and your wine, and your water, and I will turn sickness away from you.
verses.23:26: There shall be neither childless nor barren one in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
verses.23:27: And I will send dread leading before you, and I will throw into dismay all the nations to whom you come, and I will make all your adversaries fugitives.
verses.23:28: And I will send the hornets ahead of you, and you shall drive out the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites from before you.
verses.23:29: I will not drive them out in one year, lest the land become desolate and the wild beasts of the land become many against you;
verses.23:30: little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you increase and inherit the land.
verses.23:31: And I will set your borders from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness even to the great river Euphrates; and I will deliver into your hands those who dwell in the land, and I will drive them out from before you.
verses.23:32: You shall not make a covenant with them or with their gods;
verses.23:33: and they shall not dwell in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me; for if you serve their gods, these will become a stumbling block to you.
verses.24:1: And He said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and they shall worship the Lord from afar.
verses.24:2: And Moses alone shall draw near to God, but they shall not draw near; nor shall the people go up with them."
verses.24:3: Then Moses went in and recounted to the people all the words of God and the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, saying, "All the words which the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will heed."
verses.24:4: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord. And rising early in the morning, Moses built an altar beneath the mountain, and twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.24:5: And he sent forth the young men of the sons of Israel, and they offered up whole burnt offerings, and sacrificed young calves as a sacrifice of salvation to God.
verses.24:6: And Moses took half of the blood and poured it into basins, and half of the blood he poured out against the altar.
verses.24:7: And taking the book of the covenant, he read it in the ears of the people; and they said, "All things that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will heed."
verses.24:8: And Moses took the blood, sprinkled it upon the people, and said, "Behold, the blood of the covenant which the Lord has made with you concerning all these words."
verses.24:9: Then Moses went up, with Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the council of elders of Israel;
verses.24:10: and they saw the place where the God of Israel stood; and what was beneath His feet was as a work of sapphire brick, and as the appearance of the firmament of heaven in its purity.
verses.24:11: And of the chosen ones of Israel, not even one perished; and they appeared in the place of God, and they ate and drank.
verses.24:12: And the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to Me into the mountain and be there; and I will give you the stone tablets, the law and the commandments which I have written, to give as law to them."
verses.24:13: So Moses arose, with Joshua who attended him, and they went up into the mountain of God.
verses.24:14: And to the elders they said, "Remain quietly here until we return to you; and behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. If a dispute arises for anyone, let them go to them."
verses.24:15: And Moses and Joshua went up into the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
verses.24:16: And the glory of God descended upon Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days; and on the seventh day the Lord called Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.24:17: Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a blazing fire on the summit of the mountain before the sons of Israel.
verses.24:18: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud and went up into the mountain; and he was there in the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.25:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.25:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and take firstfruits from all to whom it seems good in their heart; and you shall receive My firstfruits.
verses.25:3: And this is the firstfruit offering which you shall receive from them: gold, and silver, and bronze,
verses.25:4: and blue, and purple, and double-dyed scarlet, and spun fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.25:5: and rams' skins dyed red, and blue-dyed skins, and incorruptible wood,
verses.25:7: and sardius stones, and stones for engraving, for the shoulder-garment and the full-length robe.
verses.25:8: And you shall make Me a sanctuary, and I will appear among you.
verses.25:9: And you shall make for Me according to all things that I show you on the mountain: the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its furnishings; thus you shall make it.
verses.25:10: And you shall make an ark of testimony of incorruptible wood: two and a half cubits its length, and one and a half cubits its breadth, and one and a half cubits its height.
verses.25:11: And you shall overlay it with pure gold; outside and inside you shall gild it; and you shall make for it wreathed moldings of gold all around.
verses.25:12: And you shall beat out for it four gold rings and put them upon the four sides: two rings on the one side, and two rings on the second side.
verses.25:13: And you shall make carrying poles of incorruptible wood, and you shall overlay them with gold;
verses.25:14: and you shall insert the carrying poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark with them.
verses.25:15: In the rings of the ark the carrying poles shall remain immovable.
verses.25:16: And you shall place into the ark the testimonies which I shall give you.
verses.25:17: And you shall make a mercy seat, a cover of pure gold: two and a half cubits its length, and one and a half cubits its breadth.
verses.25:18: And you shall make two cherubim of wrought gold, and you shall set them on both sides of the mercy seat;
verses.25:19: they shall be made one cherub on this side and one cherub on the second side of the mercy seat; and you shall make the two cherubim upon the two sides.
verses.25:20: The cherubim shall stretch out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall be toward one another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.
verses.25:21: And you shall set the mercy seat upon the ark above, and into the ark you shall place the testimonies which I shall give you.
verses.25:22: And I will make Myself known to you from there, and I will speak to you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, and concerning all things that I shall command you for the sons of Israel.
verses.25:23: And you shall make a golden table of pure gold: two cubits its length, and one cubit its width, and one and a half cubits its height.
verses.25:24: And you shall make for it wreathed moldings of gold all around; and you shall make for it a rim of a handbreadth all around;
verses.25:25: and you shall make a wreathed molding for the rim all around.
verses.25:26: And you shall make four gold rings, and you shall set the four rings upon the four parts of its feet beneath the rim;
verses.25:27: and the rings shall be as holders for the carrying poles, so as to bear the table with them.
verses.25:28: And you shall make the carrying poles of incorruptible wood, and you shall overlay them with pure gold, and the table shall be borne with them.
verses.25:29: And you shall make its dishes, and its censers, and its libation bowls, and its ladles, with which you shall pour drink offerings; of pure gold you shall make them.
verses.25:30: And you shall set upon the table loaves of the Presence before Me continually.
verses.25:31: And you shall make a lampstand of pure gold; of wrought work you shall make the lampstand: its shaft, and its branches, and its cups, and its knobs, and its lilies shall be of one piece with it.
verses.25:32: And six branches shall proceed from its sides: three branches of the lampstand from its one side, and three branches of the lampstand from its second side.
verses.25:33: And there shall be three cups shaped like nuts on the one branch, a knob and a lily; thus for the six branches proceeding out of the lampstand.
verses.25:34: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like nuts; on the one branch, knobs and its lilies.
verses.25:35: The knob beneath the two branches shall be of one piece with it, and a knob beneath the four branches shall be of one piece with it; thus for the six branches proceeding out of the lampstand. And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like nuts.
verses.25:36: The knobs and the branches shall be of one piece with it; the whole of it shall be wrought from one piece of pure gold.
verses.25:37: And you shall make its seven lamps; and you shall set on the lamps, and they shall give light from the one front.
verses.25:38: And its oil funnel and its trays you shall make of pure gold;
verses.25:39: all these furnishings shall be a talent of pure gold.
verses.25:40: See that you make them according to the pattern which was shown to you on the mountain."
verses.26:1: And you shall make the tabernacle of ten curtains of twisted fine linen, and blue, and purple, and twisted scarlet; you shall make them with cherubim, the work of a weaver.
verses.26:2: The length of one curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of one curtain shall be four cubits; all the curtains shall have the same measure.
verses.26:3: Now five curtains shall be joined together, one to another, and five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.26:4: And you shall make for them loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain on the one side at the joining; and thus you shall also do on the edge of the outermost curtain at the second joining.
verses.26:5: Fifty loops you shall make on the one curtain, and fifty loops you shall make on the side of the curtain at the joining of the second, facing and answering one another, each to each.
verses.26:6: And you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and join the curtains one to another with the clasps; and the tabernacle shall be one.
verses.26:7: And you shall make curtains of hair as a covering over the tabernacle; eleven curtains you shall make them.
verses.26:8: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of one curtain; the eleven curtains shall have the same measure.
verses.26:9: And you shall join five curtains together, and six curtains together; and you shall fold over the sixth curtain at the front of the tabernacle.
verses.26:10: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is in the middle at the joining, and fifty loops you shall make on the edge of the second joining curtain.
verses.26:11: And you shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and join the clasps into the loops, and join the curtains together, and it shall be one.
verses.26:12: And you shall place beneath the excess of the curtains of the tabernacle; you shall cover underneath at the rear of the tabernacle:
verses.26:13: a cubit on this side and a cubit on that side, of what overhangs of the curtains, of the length of the curtains of the tabernacle; it shall cover over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, that it may cover it.
verses.26:14: And you shall make a covering for the tabernacle of rams' skins dyed red, and outer coverings of blue skins above them.
verses.26:15: And you shall make pillars for the tabernacle of incorruptible wood.
verses.26:16: Ten cubits you shall make one pillar, and one cubit and a half shall be the width of one pillar;
verses.26:17: two tenons for one pillar, set opposite one another; thus you shall do for all the pillars of the tabernacle.
verses.26:18: And you shall make pillars for the tabernacle, twenty pillars on the side toward the north.
verses.26:19: And forty bases of silver you shall make for the twenty pillars, two bases for one pillar on both sides of it.
verses.26:20: And for the second side, toward the south, twenty pillars,
verses.26:21: and their forty bases of silver, two bases for one pillar on both sides of it.
verses.26:22: And for the rear of the tabernacle, on the side toward the sea, you shall make six pillars.
verses.26:23: And two pillars you shall make at the corners of the tabernacle at the rear,
verses.26:24: and it shall be even from below; in the same way they shall be equal at their tops into one joining; thus you shall do for both of them, and they shall be for the two corners.
verses.26:25: And there shall be eight pillars, and their sixteen bases of silver: two bases for one pillar on both sides of it, and two bases for the next pillar.
verses.26:26: And you shall make bars of incorruptible wood: five for the one pillar on the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.26:27: and five bars for the pillar on the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the rear pillar on the side of the tabernacle toward the sea.
verses.26:28: And the middle bar in the midst of the pillars shall pass through from the one side to the other side.
verses.26:29: And you shall overlay the pillars with gold, and you shall make the rings of gold into which you shall insert the bars; and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
verses.26:30: And you shall raise up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown to you on the mountain.
verses.26:31: And you shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and twisted scarlet, and spun fine linen; of woven work you shall make it with cherubim.
verses.26:32: And you shall place it upon four pillars of incorruptible wood overlaid with gold; and their capitals shall be of gold, and their four bases of silver.
verses.26:33: And you shall set the veil upon the pillars, and you shall bring in there, within the veil, the ark of the testimony; and the veil shall divide for you between the Holy Place and the Holy of Holies.
verses.26:34: And you shall conceal with the veil the ark of the testimony in the Holy of Holies.
verses.26:35: And you shall place the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and the table you shall set on the side of the tabernacle toward the north.
verses.26:36: And you shall make a screen of blue, and purple, and twisted scarlet, and twisted fine linen, the work of an embroiderer.
verses.26:37: And you shall make for the veil five pillars, and overlay them with gold; and their capitals shall be of gold; and you shall cast for them five bases of bronze.
verses.27:1: And you shall make an altar of incorruptible wood, five cubits in length and five cubits in width; the altar shall be square, and its height shall be three cubits.
verses.27:2: And you shall make the horns upon the four corners; the horns shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay them with bronze.
verses.27:3: And you shall make a rim for the altar, and its cover, and its basins, and its fleshhooks, and its firepan; and all its utensils you shall make of bronze.
verses.27:4: And you shall make for it a bronze grate of network; and you shall make for the grate four bronze rings under the four sides.
verses.27:5: And you shall place them underneath the grate of the altar below; and the grate shall extend to halfway up the altar.
verses.27:6: And you shall make poles for the altar of incorruptible wood, and overlay them with bronze.
verses.27:7: And you shall insert the poles into the rings; and the poles shall be along the sides of the altar when carrying it.
verses.27:8: Hollow with boards you shall make it; according to what was shown to you on the mountain, so you shall make it.
verses.27:9: And you shall make a court for the tabernacle: for the side toward the southwest there shall be hangings of the court, one hundred cubits in length for the one side;
verses.27:10: and their pillars shall be twenty, and their twenty bases of bronze; and their hooks and their bands shall be of silver.
verses.27:11: Likewise for the side toward the east there shall be hangings one hundred cubits in length; and their pillars shall be twenty, and their twenty bases of bronze; and the hooks and the bands of the pillars and their bases shall be overlaid with silver.
verses.27:12: And for the width of the court toward the sea there shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars shall be ten, and their bases ten.
verses.27:13: And for the width of the court toward the south there shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars shall be ten, and their bases ten.
verses.27:14: And fifteen cubits shall be the height of the hangings on the one side; their pillars shall be three, and their bases three.
verses.27:15: And for the second side, fifteen cubits shall be the height of the hangings; their pillars shall be three, and their bases three.
verses.27:16: And for the gate of the court there shall be a covering, twenty cubits in height, of blue, and purple, and twisted scarlet, and twisted fine linen, with the variegated work of an embroiderer; their pillars shall be four, and their bases four.
verses.27:17: All the pillars of the court all around shall be overlaid with silver; their capitals shall be of silver, and their bases of bronze.
verses.27:18: And the length of the court shall be one hundred by one hundred, and the width fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of twisted fine linen, and their bases of bronze.
verses.27:19: And all the equipment, and all the instruments, and the pegs of the court shall be of bronze.
verses.27:20: And you, command the sons of Israel, and let them take for you olive oil free of dregs, pure and beaten, for light to burn, that a lamp may burn continually
verses.27:21: in the tabernacle of the testimony, outside the veil that is over the covenant; Aaron and his sons shall burn it from evening until morning before the Lord, an everlasting statute throughout your generations from the sons of Israel.
verses.28:1: And you, bring near to yourself both Aaron your brother and his sons from among the sons of Israel, to minister as priests to Me—Aaron, and Nadab and Abihu and Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron.
verses.28:2: And you shall make a holy vestment for Aaron your brother, for honor and glory.
verses.28:3: And you, speak to all those who are wise in understanding, whom I have filled with a spirit of perception, and they shall make the holy vestment of Aaron for the sanctuary, in which he shall minister as priest to Me.
verses.28:4: And these are the vestments which they shall make: the breastpiece, and the ephod, and the full-length tasseled tunic, and a turban, and a sash. And they shall make holy vestments for Aaron and for his sons, to minister as priests to Me.
verses.28:5: And they shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
verses.28:6: And they shall make the ephod of twisted fine linen, the work of an embroidering weaver.
verses.28:7: It shall have two shoulder-pieces joining one to the other, fitted upon the two sides.
verses.28:8: And the woven band of the shoulder-pieces, which is upon it, shall be of the same workmanship and of one piece with it, of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and twisted fine linen.
verses.28:9: And you shall take the two stones, emerald stones, and you shall engrave upon them the names of the sons of Israel:
verses.28:10: six names upon the one stone, and the remaining six names upon the second stone, according to their births.
verses.28:11: As the work of a stonecutter's craft, like the engraving of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones upon
verses.28:12: the shoulders of the ephod. They are stones of memorial for the sons of Israel; and Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel before the Lord upon his two shoulders, as a memorial concerning them.
verses.28:13: And you shall make small shields of pure gold.
verses.28:14: And you shall make two tassels of pure gold, intermingled with flowers, of braided work; and you shall place the braided tassels upon the small shields along their shoulder-pieces on the front.
verses.28:15: And you shall make an oracle of judgments, the work of an embroiderer; according to the pattern of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, and blue, and purple, and twisted scarlet, and twisted fine linen
verses.28:16: you shall make it. It shall be square, doubled; a span shall be its length, and a span its breadth.
verses.28:17: And you shall weave into it a stone-set fabric of four rows. There shall be a row of stones: sardius, topaz, and emerald shall be the first row;
verses.28:18: and the second row: carbuncle, and sapphire, and jasper;
verses.28:19: and the third row: ligure, agate, and amethyst;
verses.28:20: and the fourth row: chrysolite, and beryl, and onyx. They shall be encased in gold, bound together in gold, according to their row.
verses.28:21: And the stones shall be from the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like engravings of signets, each according to the name, they shall be for twelve tribes.
verses.28:22: And you shall make upon the oracle interwoven tassels, chainwork of pure gold.
verses.28:29: And Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel upon the oracle of judgment on his breast when he enters into the sanctuary, as a memorial before God. And you shall place the tassels upon the oracle of judgment; the chainwork you shall set upon both sides of the oracle, and the two small shields you shall set upon both shoulders of the ephod on the front.
verses.28:30: And you shall place upon the oracle of judgment the Manifestation and the Truth; and it shall be upon the breast of Aaron whenever he enters into the sanctuary before the Lord. And Aaron shall bear the judgments of the sons of Israel upon his breast before the Lord continually.
verses.28:31: And you shall make a full-length under-robe wholly of blue.
verses.28:32: And the neck opening shall be in the middle of it, having a border all around the opening, the work of a weaver, with the seam woven together out of it, lest it be torn.
verses.28:33: And beneath the hem of the under-robe at the bottom you shall make small pomegranates as of a blossoming pomegranate, of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and twisted fine linen, upon the hem of the under-robe all around; of the same form, small golden pomegranates, and bells between them all around:
verses.28:34: beside a small golden pomegranate, a bell and a blossom, upon the hem of the under-robe all around.
verses.28:35: And while Aaron ministers, its sound shall be heard when he enters into the sanctuary before the Lord and when he goes out, lest he die.
verses.28:36: And you shall make a plate of pure gold, and you shall engrave upon it, like the engraving of a signet: "Holiness of the Lord."
verses.28:37: And you shall place it upon twisted blue, and it shall be upon the miter; upon the front of the miter it shall be.
verses.28:38: And it shall be upon the forehead of Aaron, and Aaron shall take away the sins of the holy things, whatever the sons of Israel may consecrate in every gift of their holy things; and it shall be upon the forehead of Aaron continually, acceptable for them before the Lord.
verses.28:39: And the tassels of the tunics shall be of fine linen; and you shall make a turban of fine linen, and a sash you shall make, the work of an embroiderer.
verses.28:40: And for the sons of Aaron you shall make tunics and sashes, and turbans you shall make for them, for honor and glory.
verses.28:41: And you shall clothe Aaron your brother with them, and his sons with him; and you shall anoint them, and fill their hands, and sanctify them, that they may minister as priests to Me.
verses.28:42: And you shall make for them linen breeches to cover the nakedness of their flesh; from the loins to the thighs they shall reach.
verses.28:43: And Aaron and his sons shall wear them whenever they enter into the tabernacle of testimony, when they approach to minister at the altar of the sanctuary; and they shall not bring sin upon themselves, lest they die. It shall be an everlasting ordinance for him and for his seed after him.
verses.29:1: And these are the things which you shall do to them: you shall sanctify them so that they may minister as priests to Me. You shall take one young bull from the herd and two rams without blemish,
verses.29:2: and unleavened loaves mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil; of fine wheat flour you shall make them.
verses.29:3: And you shall place them in one basket, and you shall bring them in the basket, along with the young bull and the two rams.
verses.29:4: And Aaron and his sons you shall bring to the doors of the tabernacle of witness, and you shall wash them with water.
verses.29:5: And taking the garments, you shall clothe Aaron your brother with the full-length tunic, and the shoulder-piece, and the oracle against the shoulder-piece.
verses.29:6: And you shall put the turban upon his head, and you shall place the plate of holiness upon the turban.
verses.29:7: And you shall take some of the anointing oil and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
verses.29:8: And you shall bring his sons forward, and clothe them with tunics.
verses.29:9: And you shall gird them with the sashes, and put the headdresses upon them; and the priesthood to Me shall be theirs forever. And you shall consecrate the hands of Aaron and the hands of his sons.
verses.29:10: And you shall bring the bull to the doors of the tabernacle of witness, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the bull before the Lord beside the doors of the tabernacle of witness.
verses.29:11: And you shall slaughter the bull before the Lord beside the doors of the tabernacle of witness.
verses.29:12: And you shall take some of the blood of the bull, and put it upon the horns of the altar with your finger; and all the remaining blood you shall pour out beside the base of the altar.
verses.29:13: And you shall take all the fat that is upon the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, and place them upon the altar.
verses.29:14: But the flesh of the bull, and the hide, and the dung you shall burn up with fire outside the camp; for it is a sin offering.
verses.29:15: And you shall take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.29:16: And you shall slaughter it, and taking the blood, you shall pour it against the altar all around.
verses.29:17: And you shall cut the ram into pieces according to its limbs, and wash the inward parts and the feet with water, and lay the cut pieces together with the head.
verses.29:18: And you shall offer up the whole ram upon the altar, a whole burnt offering to the Lord for a sweet-smelling aroma; it shall be an incense offering to the Lord.
verses.29:19: And you shall take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.29:20: And you shall slaughter it, and take some of its blood, and put it upon the lobe of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of his right hand, and upon the tip of his right foot, and upon the lobes of the right ears of his sons, and upon the tips of their right hands, and upon the tips of their right feet.
verses.29:21: And you shall take some of the blood that is from the altar and some of the oil of anointing, and sprinkle it upon Aaron and upon his garment, and upon his sons and upon the garments of his sons with him; and he shall be sanctified, and his garment, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him. And the blood of the ram you shall pour against the altar all around.
verses.29:22: And you shall take from the ram its fat, and the fat that covers the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for this is a consecration;
verses.29:23: and one loaf made with oil and one wafer from the basket of the unleavened loaves that are set forth before the Lord.
verses.29:24: And you shall put all these things upon the hands of Aaron and upon the hands of his sons, and you shall set apart for them a separated offering before the Lord.
verses.29:25: And you shall take them from their hands, and offer them up upon the altar of burnt offering for a sweet-smelling aroma before the Lord; it is an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.29:26: And you shall take the breast from the ram of consecration, which belongs to Aaron, and set it apart as a separated offering before the Lord; and it shall be yours as a portion.
verses.29:27: And you shall sanctify the breast as a separated offering and the shoulder of the contribution, which has been set apart and which has been taken up, from the ram of consecration, from that which belongs to Aaron and from that which belongs to his sons.
verses.29:28: And it shall be for Aaron and for his sons a perpetual statute from the children of Israel; for this is a separated offering, and it shall be a contribution from the children of Israel, from the sacrifices of deliverance of the children of Israel, a contribution to the Lord.
verses.29:29: And the apparel of the sanctuary which belongs to Aaron shall be for his sons after him, that they may be anointed in them and consecrate their hands.
verses.29:30: For seven days the priest who takes his place from among his sons shall put them on, who enters into the tabernacle of witness to minister in the sanctuary.
verses.29:31: And you shall take the ram of consecration and boil the flesh in a holy place.
verses.29:32: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the loaves that are in the basket beside the doors of the tabernacle of witness.
verses.29:33: They shall eat those things by which they were sanctified, to consecrate their hands, to sanctify them; and an outsider shall not eat of it, for they are holy.
verses.29:34: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of consecration and of the loaves remains until morning, you shall burn up what remains with fire; it shall not be eaten, for it is a holy thing.
verses.29:35: And thus you shall do to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you; for seven days you shall consecrate their hands.
verses.29:36: And you shall offer the young bull of the sin offering on the day of purification; and you shall purify the altar when you sanctify upon it, and you shall anoint it so as to sanctify it.
verses.29:37: For seven days you shall purify the altar and sanctify it, and the altar shall be most holy; everyone who touches the altar shall be sanctified.
verses.29:38: Now these are the things which you shall offer upon the altar: two lambs a year old, without blemish, each day upon the altar continually, a continual offering by fire.
verses.29:39: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer toward evening;
verses.29:40: and one-tenth of fine flour mixed with beaten oil, one-fourth of a hin, and as a drink offering one-fourth of a hin of wine, for the one lamb.
verses.29:41: And the second lamb you shall offer toward evening; according to the morning sacrifice and according to its drink offering you shall offer it, a sweet-smelling aroma, an offering by fire to the Lord,
verses.29:42: a continual sacrifice throughout your generations, at the doors of the tabernacle of witness before the Lord, in which I will be made known to you from there, so as to speak to you.
verses.29:43: And I will give orders there to the children of Israel, and I will be sanctified in My glory.
verses.29:44: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of witness and the altar; and Aaron and his sons I will sanctify to minister as priests to Me.
verses.29:45: And I will be called upon among the children of Israel, and I will be their God.
verses.29:46: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, to be called upon by them and to be their God.
verses.30:1: And you shall make an altar of incense of incorruptible wood.
verses.30:2: And you shall make it a cubit in length and a cubit in width; it shall be foursquare; and two cubits in height; its horns shall be of one piece with it.
verses.30:3: And you shall overlay them with pure gold—its hearth, its sides all around, and its horns—and you shall make for it a twisted crown of gold all around.
verses.30:4: And you shall make two rings of pure gold beneath its twisted crown for the two flanks; you shall make them on the two sides, and they shall be holders for the poles, so as to carry it with them.
verses.30:5: And you shall make poles of incorruptible wood, and you shall overlay them with gold.
verses.30:6: And you shall set it before the veil that is over the ark of the testimonies, in which I will be made known to you from there.
verses.30:7: And Aaron shall offer upon it fine compounded incense; morning by morning, when he trims the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
verses.30:8: And when Aaron lights the lamps in the evening, you shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense continually before the Lord throughout their generations.
verses.30:9: And he shall not offer up upon it strange incense, nor a burnt offering, nor a sacrifice; and you shall not pour a drink offering upon it.
verses.30:10: And Aaron shall make atonement for it upon its horns once a year; from the blood of the purification he shall cleanse it throughout their generations. It is most holy to the Lord.
verses.30:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.30:12: "When you take the reckoning of the sons of Israel in their numbering, each one shall give a ransom for his soul to the Lord, and there shall be no downfall among them in their numbering.
verses.30:13: And this is what all who pass through the numbering shall give: half a didrachma, which is according to the sacred didrachma—twenty obols are the didrachma—and the half didrachma shall be an offering to the Lord.
verses.30:14: Everyone who passes into the numbering, from twenty years old and above, shall give the offering to the Lord.
verses.30:15: The rich shall not add to, and the poor shall not diminish from, the half didrachma when giving the offering to the Lord to make atonement for your souls.
verses.30:16: And you shall receive the silver of the offering from the sons of Israel, and you shall give it for the work of the tabernacle of testimony; and it shall be a memorial for the sons of Israel before the Lord, and to make atonement for your souls."
verses.30:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.30:18: "Make a bronze laver and a bronze base for it, for washing; and you shall place it between the tabernacle of testimony and the altar, and you shall pour water into it.
verses.30:19: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it with water.
verses.30:20: When they enter the tabernacle of testimony, they shall wash with water and shall by no means die; when they approach the altar to minister and to offer up the whole burnt offerings to the Lord,
verses.30:21: they shall wash their hands and their feet with water; when they enter the tabernacle of testimony, they shall wash with water, lest they die; and it shall be a perpetual statute for them, for him and for his generations after him."
verses.30:22: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.30:23: "And you, take spices: of the flower of choice myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half of that, two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant calamus, two hundred and fifty;
verses.30:24: and of iris, five hundred shekels of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
verses.30:25: And you shall make it a holy anointing oil, a perfumed ointment by the skill of a perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.
verses.30:26: And with it you shall anoint the tabernacle of testimony and the ark of testimony,
verses.30:27: and the lampstand and all its vessels, and the tabernacle of testimony and all its vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.30:28: and the altar of whole burnt offerings and all its vessels, and the table and all its vessels, and the laver.
verses.30:29: And you shall sanctify them, and they shall be most holy; everyone who touches them shall be sanctified.
verses.30:30: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them to serve as priests to Me.
verses.30:31: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'This shall be a holy oil, an ointment of anointing to you throughout your generations.
verses.30:32: It shall not be anointed upon human flesh, nor shall any be made for yourselves like it according to this composition; it is holy, and it shall be a holy thing to you.
verses.30:33: Whoever makes any like it, and whoever gives any of it to an outsider, shall be utterly destroyed from his people.'"
verses.30:34: And the Lord said to Moses, "Take for yourself spices: stacte, onycha, fragrant galbanum, and clear frankincense; there shall be an equal amount of each.
verses.30:35: And they shall make with it a perfumed incense, the work of a perfumer, blended together, a pure and holy work.
verses.30:36: And you shall beat some of these very fine, and set it before the testimonies in the tabernacle of testimony, from which place I will be made known to you; it shall be most holy to you.
verses.30:37: You shall not make for yourselves incense according to this composition; it shall be a holy thing to you for the Lord.
verses.30:38: Whoever makes any like it so as to smell it shall perish from his people."
verses.31:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:2: "Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.31:3: And I have filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom and understanding and knowledge in every work,
verses.31:4: to devise designs and to act as a master craftsman, to work in gold and silver and bronze, and in blue and purple and spun scarlet,
verses.31:5: and in stoneworking, and in the carpentry works of wood, to labor in accordance with all the works.
verses.31:6: And I have appointed him and Eliab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, and to everyone who is understanding in heart I have given understanding;
verses.31:7: and they shall make all things that I have commanded you: the tabernacle of testimony, and the ark of the covenant, and the mercy seat that is upon it, and the furnishings of the tabernacle,
verses.31:8: and the altars, and the table and all its vessels, and the pure lampstand and all its vessels,
verses.31:9: and the laver and its base,
verses.31:10: and the ministering garments of Aaron and the garments of his sons to serve as priests to Me,
verses.31:11: and the anointing oil and the compounded incense of the sanctuary; according to all that I have commanded you, they shall make them."
verses.31:12: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:13: "And you, command the sons of Israel, saying, 'Take heed and keep My Sabbaths; it is a sign with Me and among you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.31:14: And you shall keep the Sabbaths, for this is a holy thing of the Lord for you; he who profanes it shall surely be put to death; everyone who does work on it, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from the midst of his people.
verses.31:15: Six days you shall do work, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath, a holy rest to the Lord; everyone who does work on the seventh day shall be put to death.
verses.31:16: And the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbaths, to observe them throughout their generations—
verses.31:17: an everlasting covenant between Me and the sons of Israel. It is an everlasting sign with Me; for in six days the Lord made the heaven and the earth, and on the seventh day He ceased and rested.'"
verses.31:18: And He gave to Moses, when He had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone written by the finger of God.
verses.32:1: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered together against Aaron and said to him, "Arise and make for us gods who shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him."
verses.32:2: And Aaron said to them, "Take off the golden earrings that are in the ears of your wives and daughters, and bring them to me."
verses.32:3: So all the people took off the golden earrings that were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.
verses.32:4: And he received them from their hands, fashioned them with an engraving tool, and made them into a molten calf; and he said, "These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt."
verses.32:5: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, saying, "Tomorrow is a feast of the Lord."
verses.32:6: And rising early the next day, he offered up whole burnt offerings and presented a sacrifice of deliverance; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.32:7: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Go quickly from here, go down; for your people whom you brought out of the land of Egypt have acted lawlessly.
verses.32:8: They have quickly turned aside from the way which you commanded them; they have made for themselves a calf, and have worshiped it, and have said, 'These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.'
verses.32:10: And now leave Me alone, and being kindled with wrath against them I will utterly destroy them, and I will make you into a great nation."
verses.32:11: Then Moses pleaded before the Lord God and said, "Why, O Lord, are You enraged with wrath against Your people, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great strength and with Your uplifted arm?
verses.32:12: Lest the Egyptians speak, saying, 'With evil intent He brought them out to slay them in the mountains and to consume them from the earth.' Cease from the anger of Your wrath, and be merciful concerning the wickedness of Your people,
verses.32:13: remembering Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Your servants, to whom You swore by Yourself and spoke to them, saying, 'I will greatly multiply your seed as the stars of heaven in multitude,' and all this land which You spoke to give to them, and they shall possess it forever."
verses.32:14: And the Lord was appeased, so as to preserve His people.
verses.32:15: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, and the two tablets of the Testimony were in his hands, tablets of stone inscribed on both their sides; on the one side and on the other they were written.
verses.32:16: And the tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved upon the tablets.
verses.32:17: And when Joshua heard the sound of the people shouting, he said to Moses, "There is a sound of war in the camp."
verses.32:18: And he said, "It is not the sound of those leading a song of might, nor the sound of those leading a song of defeat; rather, I hear the sound of those leading a song of wine."
verses.32:19: And as he drew near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dances; and being enraged with wrath, Moses cast the two tablets from his hands and shattered them beneath the mountain.
verses.32:20: And taking the calf which they had made, he burned it in the fire, ground it fine, scattered it into the water, and made the sons of Israel drink it.
verses.32:21: And Moses said to Aaron, "What did this people do to you that you have brought a great sin upon them?"
verses.32:22: And Aaron said to Moses, "Do not be angry, my lord; for you know the impulse of this people.
verses.32:23: For they said to me, 'Make for us gods who shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.'
verses.32:24: And I said to them, 'If anyone has gold ornaments, take them off.' So they gave them to me, and I cast them into the fire, and this calf came out."
verses.32:25: And Moses saw that the people were scattered—for Aaron had scattered them as an object of derision to their adversaries.
verses.32:26: Then Moses stood at the gate of the camp and said, "Who is for the Lord? Let him come to me." Therefore all the sons of Levi came together.
verses.32:27: And he said to them, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: 'Let every man put his sword upon his thigh, and pass through and return from gate to gate throughout the camp, and let every man slay his brother and every man his nearest neighbor.'"
verses.32:28: And the sons of Levi did according to what Moses had spoken to them; and there fell of the people on that day about three thousand men.
verses.32:29: And Moses said to them, "You have filled your hands today for the Lord, each man against his son or his brother, that a blessing may be given upon you."
verses.32:30: And it came to pass on the following day that Moses said to the people, "You have committed a great sin. And now I will go up to God, that I may make atonement for your sin."
verses.32:31: Then Moses returned to the Lord and said, "I plead with You, O Lord: this people has committed a great sin, and they have made for themselves gods of gold;
verses.32:32: and now, if You will forgive them their sin, forgive it; but if not, blot me out of Your book which You have written."
verses.32:33: And the Lord said to Moses, "If anyone has sinned, I will blot them out of My book.
verses.32:34: But as for you, go, go down, and lead this people to the place of which I spoke to you; behold, My angel goes before your face; and on whichever day I visit, I will bring their sin upon them."
verses.32:35: And the Lord struck the people because of the making of the calf which Aaron had made.
verses.33:1: And the Lord said to Moses, "Depart, go up from here, you and your people whom you brought out of the land of Egypt, to the land which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, 'To your seed I will give it.'
verses.33:2: And I will send My angel along before your face, and you shall drive out the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.33:3: And I will bring you into a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will by no means go up with you, because you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way."
verses.33:4: And when the people heard this grievous word, they mourned deeply in mourning attire.
verses.33:5: And the Lord said to the sons of Israel, "You are a stiff-necked people; beware lest I bring another plague upon you and consume you; now therefore take off your robes of glory and your ornaments, and I will show you what I will do to you."
verses.33:6: So the sons of Israel took off their ornaments and their robes from Mount Horeb.
verses.33:7: And Moses took his tent and pitched it outside the camp, far off from the camp, and it was called the Tent of Testimony; and it came to pass that everyone who sought the Lord went out to the tent outside the camp.
verses.33:8: And whenever Moses went into the tent outside the camp, all the people stood watching, each man at the door of his tent, and they watched Moses as he departed until he entered into the tent.
verses.33:9: And whenever Moses entered into the tent, the pillar of the cloud descended and stood at the door of the tent, and He spoke to Moses.
verses.33:10: And all the people saw the pillar of the cloud standing at the door of the tent; and all the people rose up and worshiped, each man from the door of his tent.
verses.33:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as if a man should speak to his own friend. Then he would return to the camp, but his attendant Joshua the son of Nave, a young man, did not depart from the tent.
verses.33:12: And Moses said to the Lord, "Behold, You say to me, 'Bring up this people,' yet You have not made known to me whom You will send along with me; and You have said to me, 'I know you above all others, and you have favor with Me.'
verses.33:13: If therefore I have found favor before You, manifest Yourself to me; let me see You clearly, so that I may have found favor before You, and that I may know that this great nation is Your people."
verses.33:14: And He said, "I Myself will go before you, and I will give you rest."
verses.33:15: And he said to Him, "If You Yourself do not go, do not bring me up from here.
verses.33:16: And how shall it truly be known that I have found favor with You, both I and Your people, except by Your going along with us? Then both I and Your people shall be glorified above all the nations that are upon the earth."
verses.33:17: And the Lord said to Moses, "I will also do for you this word which you have spoken; for you have found favor before Me, and I know you above all others."
verses.33:18: And he said, "Manifest Yourself to me."
verses.33:19: And He said, "I will pass by before you in My glory, and I will speak by My name, 'the Lord,' before you; and I will show mercy to whomever I show mercy, and I will have compassion on whomever I have compassion."
verses.33:20: And He said, "You will not be able to see My face; for no man shall see My face and live."
verses.33:21: And the Lord said, "Behold, there is a place by Me; you shall stand upon the rock;
verses.33:22: and when My glory passes by, I will place you in a cleft of the rock, and I will shield you with My hand until I have passed by;
verses.33:23: and I will remove My hand, and then you shall see My back, but My face shall not be seen by you."
verses.34:1: And the Lord said to Moses, "Carve for yourself two stone tablets like the first ones, and come up to Me onto the mountain, and I will write upon the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered.
verses.34:2: And be ready for the morning, and you shall ascend Mount Sinai, and stand before Me there on the summit of the mountain.
verses.34:3: And let no one ascend with you, nor let anyone be seen on all the mountain; and let neither the sheep nor the cattle graze near that mountain."
verses.34:4: And he carved two stone tablets just like the first ones; and rising early in the morning, Moses ascended Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded him, and Moses took the two stone tablets.
verses.34:5: And the Lord descended in a cloud and stood beside him there, and called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.34:6: And the Lord passed before his face, and proclaimed, "The Lord God, compassionate and merciful, longsuffering and abounding in mercy and true,
verses.34:7: and keeping righteousness and mercy for thousands, taking away iniquities and unrighteousness and sins; and He will not acquit the guilty, bringing the iniquities of fathers upon children and upon children's children, to the third and fourth generation."
verses.34:8: And Moses hastened, bowed down to the earth, and worshiped,
verses.34:9: and said, "If I have found favor before You, let my Lord go along with us; for the people are stiff-necked, and You shall take away our sins and our iniquities, and we shall be Yours."
verses.34:10: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I establish a covenant with you before all your people; I will perform glorious deeds that have not been done in all the earth or in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the works of the Lord, for wondrous are the things that I will do for you.
verses.34:11: Give heed yourself to all things that I command you; behold, I am driving out before your face the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Perizzite and the Hittite and the Hivite and the Girgashite and the Jebusite.
verses.34:12: Take heed to yourself, lest you ever make a covenant with those who dwell in the land into which you are entering, lest it become a stumbling block to you in your midst.
verses.34:13: Their altars you shall tear down, and their pillars you shall shatter, and their groves you shall cut down, and the carved images of their gods you shall burn completely in fire.
verses.34:14: For you shall by no means worship other gods; for the Lord God, a jealous name, is a jealous God;
verses.34:15: lest you make a covenant with those who dwell among foreigners in the land, and they play the harlot after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and invite you and you eat of their sacrifices,
verses.34:16: and you take of their daughters for your sons, and give of your daughters to their sons, and your daughters play the harlot after their gods, and your sons play the harlot after their gods.
verses.34:17: And you shall not make for yourself molten gods.
verses.34:18: And you shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, just as I have commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of new produce; for in the month of new produce you came out of Egypt.
verses.34:19: Everything that opens the womb—the males are Mine, every firstborn of a calf and firstborn of a sheep.
verses.34:20: And the firstborn of a beast of burden you shall redeem with a sheep; and if you do not redeem it, you shall pay a price. Every firstborn of your sons you shall redeem; you shall not appear before Me empty-handed.
verses.34:21: Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh there shall be rest; in sowing and in harvest there shall be rest.
verses.34:22: And you shall keep a Feast of Weeks for Me, the beginning of the wheat harvest, and the beginning of the ingathering in the middle of the year.
verses.34:23: Three times in the year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.34:24: For when I drive out the nations before your face and enlarge your borders, no one shall covet your land whenever you go up to appear before the Lord your God three times in the year.
verses.34:25: You shall not slaughter the blood of My incense offerings with leaven, nor shall the sacrifices of the Feast of the Passover remain overnight until the morning.
verses.34:26: The firstfruits of your land you shall place in the house of the Lord your God. You shall not offer a lamb in its mother's milk."
verses.34:27: And the Lord said to Moses, "Write for yourself these words; for upon these words I have established a covenant with you and with Israel."
verses.34:28: And Moses was there before the Lord forty days and forty nights; bread he did not eat, and water he did not drink. And he wrote these words upon the tablets of the covenant, the ten words.
verses.34:29: Now as Moses was coming down from the mountain, and the two tablets were in the hands of Moses, as he was coming down from the mountain, Moses did not know that the appearance of the skin of his face had been glorified while he was speaking with Him.
verses.34:30: And Aaron and all the elders of Israel saw Moses, and the appearance of the skin of his face was glorified; and they were afraid to draw near to him.
verses.34:31: And Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation turned back to him; and Moses spoke to them.
verses.34:32: And afterward all the sons of Israel drew near to him, and he commanded them all things that the Lord had commanded him on Mount Sinai.
verses.34:33: And when he had finished speaking to them, he placed a veil upon his face.
verses.34:34: But whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak with Him, he would remove the veil until he came out; and having come out, he would speak to all the sons of Israel whatever the Lord had commanded him.
verses.34:35: And the sons of Israel saw the face of Moses, that it was glorified; and Moses put a veil over his face until he went in to speak with Him.
verses.35:1: And Moses assembled the entire congregation of the sons of Israel and said, "These are the words that the Lord has spoken, to do them:
verses.35:2: Six days you shall do works, but on the seventh day there shall be rest, a holy thing, a Sabbath of rest to the Lord; everyone who does work on it shall die.
verses.35:3: You shall not kindle a fire in any dwelling place of yours on the Sabbath day; I am the Lord."
verses.35:4: And Moses spoke to the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, "This is the word that the Lord has commanded, saying,
verses.35:5: 'Take from among yourselves an offering for the Lord; everyone who is willing in heart shall bring the firstfruits to the Lord: gold, silver, bronze,
verses.35:6: blue, purple, twice-dyed spun scarlet, twisted fine linen, and goat hair,
verses.35:7: and ram skins dyed red, and blue-dyed skins, and incorruptible wood,
verses.35:9: and sardius stones, and stones for engraving for the ephod and the full-length robe.
verses.35:10: And let every wise-hearted person among you come and make all things that the Lord has commanded:
verses.35:11: the tabernacle, and the coverings, and the braces, and the bars, and the pillars,
verses.35:12: and the ark of the testimony, and its poles, and its mercy seat, and the veil, and the curtains of the court, and its pillars, and the emerald stones, and the incense, and the anointing oil,
verses.35:13: and the table and all its vessels,
verses.35:14: and the lampstand of the light and all its vessels,
verses.35:16: and the altar and all its vessels,
